bioconda.name: varseek
bioconda.summary: Efficient k-mer-based variant screening of RNA-seq and DNA-seq data.
bioconda.description:
varseek screens RNA-seq and DNA-seq data for known variants by building a
variant-aware k-mer reference and pseudoaligning reads against it, avoiding
a full alignment to the genome. It provides the vk build, ref, fastqpp,
count, clean, denovo and summarize subcommands.

commands: python -c "from varseek.utils.native import native_available; assert native_available('bam2vcf')"
